audience: e-commerce marketers who send email and SMS campaigns with Sendlane

useCases.title: Check opens, clicks and revenue of a campaign
useCases.text: The AI reads the report of one email campaign: sent, opens, clicks, bounces, unsubscribes, spam and revenue, for a period you set. It reads SMS reports too.

useCases.title: See who joined or left a list
useCases.text: The AI lists the contacts of a list with state, tags and lifetime value, filtered by creation time, and the contacts who unsubscribed.

useCases.title: Look at one contact's lists, tags and fields
useCases.text: The AI opens a contact with consent, lifetime value, list subscriptions, tags and custom field values.

useCases.title: Review tags and segments with their sizes
useCases.text: The AI lists tags with audience counts and segments with their match rule and last count, and the contacts in one tag or segment.

useCases.title: Add contacts to a list, tag them and set custom fields
useCases.text: The AI adds up to 100 contacts to a list, creating those that do not exist, and puts tags and custom field values on a contact.

useCases.title: Unsubscribe or remove a contact
useCases.text: The AI unsubscribes a contact from email marketing, or removes a contact from one list while the contact stays in the account.
